churn_definition.flip_fraction: Per-period fraction of names in the baseline long/short book that change side (long<->short) or drop out entirely, averaged over all periods. Baseline-vs-baseline = 0.0.
churn_definition.jaccard_overlap: Per-period Jaccard overlap of baseline vs perturbed long/short selected sets, averaged over all periods. Baseline-vs-baseline = 1.0.

provenance.fixture_recipe: Deterministic synthetic wide universe (P34 recipe). BTC prices from tests/fixtures/real_market_prices.csv. Asset returns = beta * BTC_return + idio, idio ~ N(0, 0.003), betas linspace(0.35, 1.9, 40). One all-NaN DEL column for loader robustness. Not real market data; not market profitability evidence.
